title: Apache & nginx Settings
subtitle: Security headers and custom directives. nginx vhost is re-rendered on save.
backend_desc: nginx stays at the edge as TLS terminator; the choice below routes the domain's backend to the running engine.
hsts_notice: HSTS only makes sense for HTTPS-enabled sites. If the site is HTTP-only, it is not sent to the browser. When settings change, nginx -t + reload is triggered automatically — zero downtime.
vhost_warning: ⚠️ Custom vhost is active — the security headers, cache and extra-directive settings below are not currently applied. Changes are saved but not reflected in the vhost file; click "Return to Panel Management" below for these settings to take effect again.
vhost_ozel_desc: Syntax is auto-validated with nginx -t after edit. On error the previous content is kept and logged.
vhost_placeholder:
# The full server { ... } block
# This content completely replaces /etc/nginx/conf.d/sanalcp/<domain>.conf.
ek_desc: Injected inside the server { ... } block. For directives that require custom vhost structure, edit the vhost file manually.
fastcgi_cache_desc: Caches WordPress/PHP pages on disk. POST/cookie/login/preview are automatically bypassed. Resolves the WP Site Health "page cache detected" warning.
browser_cache_desc: Static files like CSS/JS/PNG/JPG/WOFF are cached in the browser. Repeat visits load significantly faster.
hsts_desc: Browsers connect to the site only via HTTPS. A wrong configuration is hard to reverse — use with care.
subdomains_desc: Apply to all subdomains (make sure subdomains are HTTPS first)
preload_desc: Hardcode into browsers as a default (registration at hstspreload.org required)
backend_phpfpm_desc: Default. nginx calls PHP-FPM directly via fastcgi. Lowest latency; ideal for WordPress/Laravel/dynamic PHP sites.
backend_apache_desc: nginx as TLS terminator at the edge, Apache (10080) serves the vhost behind. Full .htaccess support — for Joomla, legacy WP, legacy CMSes.
backend_static_desc: File serving only — for React/Vue/Angular SPAs, static site generators (Hugo/Jekyll), CDN content. PHP calls return 404.
